mechanisms.name: Operator specification framework (abstract tensors, requires, type_transfer, infer_input_type)
mechanisms.description: Users declare each operator's input/output abstract tensor types (dtype, rank, symbolic shape), a requires() predicate list over inputs/attributes, a type_transfer() rule relating output shape to inputs/attributes, and infer_input_type() to derive input types from a desired output. These specifications encode the compiler's type-checking rules and are shared across all ONNX-accepting compilers.

evidence.quote: An operator’s specification codifies rules for checking validity and depends on its inputs and attributes
The operator uses a type transfer function (Line 16) to specify how its output tensor relates to its inputs.
NNSmith specifications are written using symbolic integers and abstract tensors.

mechanisms.boundary: Only declares constraints; does not itself solve them or generate graphs. Requires manual authoring per operator (mitigated by meta-types).
mechanisms.merge_reason: A01 与 B01 描述的是同一套算子规格框架：两者都包含抽象张量（具体 dtype/rank、符号形状）、requires() 谓词、type_transfer() 输出形状规则以及 infer_input_type() 反向推导。B01 额外强调符号整数与跨编译器共享，A01 额外强调 meta-types 缓解手工编写，这些是同一机制的不同侧面而非不同机制。

mechanisms.name: Incremental graph generation with forward/backward insertion
mechanisms.description: Starts from a single placeholder node and repeatedly inserts a randomly chosen operator either forward (connect op as consumer of existing intermediate tensors) or backward (replace a placeholder with op and create new placeholders for its inputs). Each insertion is validated by type matching then SMT constraint solving, keeping the graph connected and valid.

evidence.quote: extending it by either (a) adding a new node whose input edges are connected to the output of an existing node (we refer to this as a forward insertion) or (b) replacing an existing placeholder node
NNSmith generates connected computation graph by extending an existing graph while maintaining connectivity.
starting with a graph that contains a single placeholder node
Forward insertion (Line 6) selects one group of plausible tensors (v) as the inputs of op

mechanisms.boundary: Produces topology only; attributes are fixed later by binning. Relies on operator specs and an SMT solver.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A02 与 B02 描述同一增量图生成算法：均从单个占位节点开始，随机选择算子进行前向插入（作为现有张量的消费者）或后向插入（替换占位节点并创建新占位节点），并保持图连通。两者只是措辞不同，没有算法阶段上的区别。

mechanisms.name: Type-matching heuristic prefilter
mechanisms.description: Before invoking the SMT solver, a cheap heuristic filters candidate insertion points whose data types or ranks are obviously incompatible (e.g., non-boolean edges for Where's condition), reducing solver calls.

evidence.quote: we use a simple type matching heuristic to filter out nodes that are obviously infeasible because of incompatible data types or ranks

mechanisms.boundary: Only a prefilter; final feasibility still decided by SMT solving.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A03 与 B03 是同一预过滤步骤：在调用 SMT 求解器之前用廉价的类型/秩匹配启发式剔除明显不可行的插入点（如 Where 的非布尔条件边）。两者描述完全一致，属于同一机制。

mechanisms.name: SMT-based constraint solving with incremental solving and caching
mechanisms.description: Builds constraints from requires() and type_transfer() (plus shape>=1 constraints) and checks satisfiability with Z3, caching the model's constraints and using incremental solving to reduce overhead. The SMT model also supplies concrete attribute values.

evidence.quote: NNSmith caches constraints for the current model (in M.solver) to reduce constraint generation overheads, and uses incremental solving [5]

mechanisms.boundary: Solver alone yields boundary values, motivating attribute binning; solving adds generation overhead.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A04 与 B04 描述同一 SMT 约束求解机制：由 requires()/type_transfer() 及 shape>=1 构造约束，用 Z3 检查可满足性，并缓存当前模型的约束、使用增量求解以降低开销，SMT 模型同时给出具体属性值。两者是同一求解步骤的不同表述。

mechanisms.name: Attribute binning with exponential bins and constraint relaxation
mechanisms.description: To avoid SMT picking boundary values, each operator attribute is constrained to a randomly chosen exponential bin [2^{i-1},2^i) (last bin [2^{k-1},∞)), sampling l,r within it; specialized per-attribute strategies (C*) override defaults. If binning constraints make the system unsatisfiable, half the constraints are randomly dropped and retried.

evidence.quote: The binning constraints for each attribute are generated by randomly choosing from one of k bins, where the ith bin represents the range [2^{i−1}, 2^i)
we randomly drop half of the constraints and retry, until it succeeds
The binning constraints for each attribute are generated by randomly choosing from one of k bins
we randomly drop half of the constraints and retry, until it succeeds (Line 18)

mechanisms.boundary: Applied only after a valid graph exists; improves diversity, not validity; total-coverage gain is modest.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A05 与 B05 是同一属性分箱机制：对每个 (op, attribute) 随机选择指数区间 [2^{i-1},2^i)（最后一箱 [2^{k-1},∞)），在箱内采样 l,r 并加 l<=a<=r；算子特定 C* 策略覆盖默认；不可满足时随机丢弃一半约束重试。两者描述的是同一后处理步骤。

mechanisms.name: Tensor-inequality to loss-function conversion
mechanisms.description: Each vulnerable operator's valid input domain is expressed as inequality predicates f(X)<=0 or f(X)<0; these are converted to scalar losses via sum over elements of max(f(x),0) (or max(f(x)+epsilon,0)), giving per-operator loss functions (Table 1/2).

evidence.quote: We associate a loss function with each predicate in an operator’s tensor inequality.
Tensor inequality to loss function conversions.
We associate a loss function with each predicate in an operator’s tensor inequality.
Table 2: Tensor inequality to loss function conversions.

mechanisms.boundary: Assumes loss positive iff predicate violated; domains are under-approximations.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A06 与 B06 是同一转换机制：把脆弱算子的有效输入域写成不等式谓词，规范化为 f(X)<=0 或 f(X)<0，再用 max(f(x),0) 或 max(f(x)+epsilon,0) 对元素求和得到标量损失（Table 1/2）。两者描述同一转换步骤，只是引用表号略有差异。

mechanisms.name: Proxy derivative functions
mechanisms.description: For operators that are undifferentiable or have zero gradient in a region (Floor, Ceil, ReLU), substitute a small-magnitude signed derivative alpha (sign from function trend) or the closest left-derivative, enabling gradient back-propagation.

evidence.quote: we use Proxy Derivative Functions [4] instead of actual derivatives during gradient propagation.

mechanisms.boundary: Approximation; only used where true gradients fail.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A07 与 B08 是同一代理导数机制：对不可微或梯度为零的算子（Floor、Ceil、ReLU）用符号由函数趋势决定的小幅值常数 alpha 或最近左导数替代真实导数，使反向传播可以进行。两者描述完全一致。

mechanisms.name: Gradient-guided value search (Algorithm 3)
mechanisms.description: Randomly initialize inputs/weights, then iterate in topological order: find the first operator producing NaN/Inf, take its first positive loss, and update inputs/weights by gradient descent (Adam, learning rate reset on loss switch). Restart on zero gradient or NaN/Inf in values; fail if budget exhausted.

evidence.quote: we find the first operator (in topological order, Line 4) that produces an FP exceptional value (Line 7). We use its loss function as an optimization objective
we use Adam [25], an adaptive learning rate scheduling algorithm, to set the learning rate
we find the first operator (in topological order, Line 4) that produces an FP exceptional value (Line 7)

mechanisms.boundary: May oscillate between operators (rare); fails when model has no valid inputs.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A08 与 B07 是同一梯度引导取值搜索（Algorithm 3）：随机初始化输入/权重，按拓扑序找第一个产生 NaN/Inf 的算子，取其第一个正损失，用 Adam 梯度下降更新 <X,W>（切换损失时重置学习率），零梯度或出现 NaN/Inf 时重启，预算耗尽则失败。两者描述同一搜索过程。

mechanisms.name: Differential testing with PyTorch oracle and O0 cross-check
mechanisms.description: Compile generated model with the tested compiler and run reference (PyTorch) on the same inputs; compare outputs with magnitude-scaled tolerance. On disagreement, recompile in compiler O0 mode to localize whether the optimization is at fault.

evidence.quote: we regard PyTorch’s results as the oracle
if the compiler and PyTorch disagree on the model outputs, we further compare it with the compiler “O0” mode
we further compare it with the compiler “O0” mode at an extra cost of re-compilation

mechanisms.boundary: Tolerance can yield false alarms (e.g., Sigmoid+Floor); PyTorch converter itself can be buggy.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A09 与 B11 是同一差分测试机制：以 PyTorch 结果为 oracle，用同一输入比较被测编译器输出，按量级缩放容差判定；不一致时用编译器 O0 模式重编译以定位是否为优化错误。B11 额外标注了第 2 页的流程背景，但机制本身相同。

mechanisms.name: Compiler operator/data-type support probing
mechanisms.description: Infer which operators and data types the tested compiler supports by compiling single-operator models, then restrict graph generation to avoid Not-Implemented errors.

evidence.quote: we infer the set of operators supported by the compiler being tested by trying to compile single-operator models with different data types

mechanisms.boundary: Only a support filter; does not test unsupported paths.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A10 与 B10 是同一支持探测机制：通过编译单算子模型（不同数据类型）推断被测编译器支持的算子与 dtype 集合，并据此限制图生成以避免 Not-Implemented 错误。两者描述完全一致。

mechanisms.name: ONNX model materialization and export pipeline
mechanisms.description: Concretize the symbolic graph by invoking PyTorch functors in topological order and export to ONNX via PyTorch's exporter, making tests applicable to any ONNX-supporting system.

evidence.quote: we then concretize the symbolic graph by invoking the materialized PyTorch functors in the topological order, and export the model to the deployment-friendly ONNX [2] format

mechanisms.boundary: Inherits PyTorch exporter bugs (found as by-product); limited to ONNX-representable models.
mechanisms.merge_reason: A11 与 B09 是同一物化与导出流水线：按拓扑序调用 PyTorch functor 具体化符号图，再用 PyTorch exporter 导出为 ONNX。两者描述同一实现步骤，B09 额外说明 PyTorch 也实现取值搜索，但核心机制相同。

mechanisms.name: Operator-spec meta types and C* binning specializations
mechanisms.description: Reusable unary/binary/reduce/broadcast meta types shrink spec code; default C* binning specializations add a 0-bin for Conv2d padding, 0/negative bins for pad ops, and valid start/end ranges for Slice.

evidence.quote: we implemented several meta types including, unary/binary, reduce and broadcast that further reduce the amount of code needed to specify an operator
we specifically handle for the indexing ranges (i.e., “start” and “end” attributes) in Slice

mechanisms.boundary: Implementation convenience and attribute-range correctness; not a testing strategy.
mechanisms.merge_reason: 仅 B12 提出；A 清单未单列该实现细节。它描述可复用 meta types 与 C* 分箱特化（Conv2d padding 0 箱、pad 算子 0/负箱、Slice start/end 有效范围），是独立于通用分箱机制的实现便利与属性范围正确性机制，故保留为单独机制。

mechanisms.name: Artifact reproduction workflow
mechanisms.description: Docker image (Docker Hub or Zenodo import) plus HTML docs; run NNSmith and baselines on instrumented TVM/ONNXRuntime for 4 hours each, then visualize coverage trends and Venn diagrams.

evidence.quote: Running NNSmith and baselines on instrumented TVM and ONNXRuntime for 4 hours each to get code coverage reports.
Visualize coverage in coverage trends and Venn diagram.

mechanisms.boundary: Reproduces evaluation results; not part of the fuzzing algorithm.
mechanisms.merge_reason: 仅 B13 提出；A 清单未包含工件复现流程。它描述 Docker 镜像与 HTML 文档、在插桩 TVM/ONNXRuntime 上各跑 4 小时、可视化覆盖率趋势与 Venn 图，属于评估复现流程而非模糊测试算法，故保留为单独机制。

open_questions: B12 的 C* 分箱特化与 A05/B05 的通用属性分箱在实现上紧密耦合（C* 覆盖默认分箱），但论文将其作为实现细节单独描述；是否应把 C* 特化视为属性分箱的子机制而非独立机制，需依据更细的代码结构判断。
B13 的工件复现流程属于评估基础设施，是否应纳入“机制”清单取决于清单的收录范围（算法机制 vs 实验流程）；当前按候选保留并标注边界。
